### Minimal code example (reproducible)

```python
import re

text = "I want to [hire] a project coordinator, but I don’t want to [disclose] the budget."
syn = {"hire": "employ", "disclose": "reveal"}

def replace_bracketed(t, mapping):
    def repl(m):
        word = m.group(1)
        return mapping.get(word, word)
    return re.sub(r"\[(.+?)\]", repl, t)

print(replace_bracketed(text, syn))
```
